mx.teacher_note: Ice, liquid water, and water vapour are three different substances.

intelligence.enrichment: Water can exist as solid ice, liquid water, and gaseous water vapour; changing state does not make it a different substance. Changing the conditions around water changes its state while the substance remains water. The learner correctly applies this rule: Water can exist as solid ice, liquid water, and gaseous water vapour; changing state does not make it a different substance. Ice is hard and liquid water flows, so a hard thing and a flowing thing must be different substances.
